paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: The line plot compares the throughput (in tokens per second) of PyramidInfer and a full cache baseline across varying batch sizes, evaluated on the LLaMA 2-7B model with an input length of 512+256. The x-axis represents batch size, ranging from 0 to 64 with major tick marks at intervals of 16, and the y-axis shows throughput in tokens per second, spanning from 0 to 2500 with major gridlines every 500 tokens/s. The pink line with circle markers, labeled “PyramidInfer,” shows a steeply increasing throughput: starting near 100 tokens/s at batch size 4, rising to ~1300 at batch size 16, ~2100 at batch size 32, and reaching ~2650 at batch size 64. The teal line with circle markers, labeled “Full Cache,” increases more gradually: starting near 100 tokens/s at batch size 4, reaching ~1000 at batch size 16, peaking at ~1250 at batch size 32, and then declining slightly to ~950 at batch size 64. Both lines are plotted with solid lines connecting the markers, and the background includes light gray dashed gridlines for easier value estimation.
